title: Upland Kangkong: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Upland Kangkong: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Upland Kangkong is a kangkong variety from UPCA. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Upland Kangkong is a registered kangkong variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1970. UPCA bred it. It takes 25 to 30 days from sowing to the first harvest.

items: **Days to harvest:** 25 to 30 days from sowing to the first harvest.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Upland Kangkong takes 25 to 30 days from sowing to the first harvest. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit kangkong fields most often: [golden apple snail](/pests/golden-apple-snail), [Cercospora leaf spot](/diseases/cercospora-leaf-spot), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant Upland Kangkong

Upland kangkong grows from seed on dry beds, and lowland kangkong from cuttings in wet ground. Both regrow after each cutting. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Fertilizer for vegetables](/blog/fertilizer-for-vegetables-philippines).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 25 to 30 days from sowing to the first harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Upland Kangkong?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
